pre_scoring_choices: Frozen before comparison. Heights and stopped commands exclude ground/contact intervals; no residual-based trimming. Common eligible windows across models. Report all curve candidates without selecting installed hardware.
metrics: Prediction minus observation: per-flight per-axis bias and RMSE for body specific force, filtered angular acceleration, position, world velocity and body angular rate; attitude geodesic RMSE; failures and row/window exclusions. No acceleration ratios or pooled-sample confidence intervals.
processing: Keep published alignment, interpolation and upstream velocity derivation. No learned shifts/scales. Compare 11-sample trailing means for force; differentiate trailing-mean body gyro and compare with equally averaged Euler angular acceleration. Rate rollouts use unfiltered aligned gyro, Vicon position/velocity/quaternion only at starts. ZOH motor PWM and voltage on the published grid; no future state feedback.
baselines: Three documented cubic curves with zero force at PWM=0 and nonnegative force otherwise, measured dataset mass, explicit unmodified stock-model inertia prior, firmware arm, curve-specific torque ratio, no drag or motor lag. Persistence uses constant world velocity and body angular rate, integrating attitude. Force persistence is previous aligned specific force; angular acceleration persistence is zero.
validity: Empirical cubic calibration range and instrumented inertia are unresolved. Flag positive commands below firmware THRUST_MIN but do not treat THRUST_MAX as a physical cap. Retain these conditional predictions; report range counts. No fit, no acceptance claim, no explanation of the exploratory discrepancy.
final_test: Not scored here. Later final evaluation must supply a frozen fitted-model JSON plus a frozen protocol hash; same evaluator reports both documented curves and fitted model on the reserved whole flights.
window_selection: Use the published median grid interval to map nominal horizons/stride to sample counts. Exclude windows containing an invalid row or a gap above maximum_grid_gap_s; report actual elapsed spans. Use the same starts, eligible through the longest horizon, for all models and horizons. Whole-flight edge trimming only. Diagnostic masks require all rows in the trailing window, plus the previous row for differencing, to be eligible.
